title: Austin Funds Affordable Housing & Repairs
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved a $1 million contract with the Austin Area Urban League for an Emergency Home Repair Program, helping residents with urgent housing needs.
*   Authorized a service agreement of nearly $7.9 million to manage affordable housing programs using federal (HUD) and local funds.
*   Approved an additional service agreement of nearly $6.5 million for affordable housing programs, funded by city General Obligation Housing Bonds.

NOTICE OF MEETING
The Austin Housing Finance Corporation, Board of Directors,
will convene at 3:00 p.m. on Thursday, September 23, 2010,
in Council Chambers at Austin City Hall, 301 W. Second Street, Austin, Texas
AGENDA

closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this agenda.
1. Authorize the negotiation and execution of a twelve-month contract with the
AUSTIN AREA URBAN LEAGUE, in an amount not to exceed 51,000,000, to

2. Authorize the negotiation and execution of a one-year sendee agreement with the

Urban Development funds and local housing funds in an amount not to exceed
57,849,957.
3. Authorize the negotiation and execution of a one-year service agreement with the
City of Austin to manage and operate affordable housing programs for the City
during Fiscal Year 2010-2011 funded by proceeds from the City's General
Obligation Housing Bonds (G.O. Bonds) in an amount not to exceed 56,495,000.
